description: TEMPLATE input for the Geo-LLM voice-fidelity eval (plan 0008 step 26d). Each trial is one held-out prompt plus the candidate passages to be blind-ranked by a judge model for how well they read like Dr. George Calhoun's voice. 'candidates' maps a SOURCE label to its text. The canonical sources are 'real' (a genuine Calhoun excerpt — the gold reference), 'rag' (the dashboard's Ask Dad answer), and 'finetuned' (the QLoRA model from 26c). The harness anonymizes these to A/B/C before judging so the judge can't tell which is which. Prompts must NOT overlap the #25 RAG eval questions (eval/questions.json) or 26a's held-out split — voice fidelity is measured on fresh prompts. This file is a SHAPE template with illustrative text; the real trials are produced once the 26c adapter exists (owner-interactive) and are not committed.

trials.prompt: Write a short, opinionated paragraph on whether the Federal Reserve has become a market-backstopping institution.

candidates.real: <paste a genuine George Calhoun excerpt on the Fed here>
candidates.rag: <paste the Ask Dad RAG answer to this prompt here>

trials.prompt: Give a contrarian take on Europe's path to fiscal union.

candidates.real: <paste a genuine George Calhoun excerpt on Europe's fiscal union here>
candidates.rag: <paste the Ask Dad RAG answer to this prompt here>
